parsed.title: Discussion on tax filing, domain purchase, and low‑profit app idea

claims.text: P1 paid ~500 UAH to an uncle (Sveta) to correct a large tax error caused by a mis‑labelled column in a declaration.
The inspector ignored P1’s declarations for 1.5 years, later demanded re‑verification of all years.
With Sveta’s help P1 managed to re‑file correctly and paid about 1 000 UAH instead of the full fines.
The main difficulty is not the tax calculation itself but ensuring every column is correctly matched.
The calculator P1 uses works only with a domestic‑currency (₴) FOP; for foreign currency transactions it requires conversion based on the day’s exchange rate.
P2 mentions not having bought a domain.
P4 jokes that nobody will buy the domain.
P4 argues the domain is irrelevant because the project is a “silly thing” that won’t generate revenue.

topics.title: Viability of a low‑cost app / “vibe‑code” project

claims.text: P1 reports that web platforms are less profitable than Android/iOS and suffer from poor SEO, no external traffic, and low user retention due to paywalls.
P1 notes a successful case where fast delivery (< 1 week) using Flutter and copying popular ideas was highlighted.
P4 doubts there are even ten people willing to pay 299 UAH for the app.
P4 describes the app as a “local‑first” bundle where the paid functionality is merely hidden in the bundle.
P4 labels the project as a “free vibe‑code” experiment with little sense.
